title: entropy source metadata schema
description: JSON schema decribing a valid entropy source metatadata submission for NIST ESV

esvVersion.description: esv Version currently 1.0 and no other version is supported

primaryNoiseSource.description: brief description of noise source (64 characters)

iidClaim.description: whether an IID claim is made on the noise source

bitsPerSample.description: number of bits in a sample output of the noise source

hminEstimate.description: estimate of the entropy in one sample out of the noise source, value must be between 0.0 and value of bitsPerSample

physical.description: whether the noise source is physical or non-physical

numberOfRestarts.description: number of restarts used to perform the restart tests

samplesPerRestart.description: number of samples generated per restart to perform the restart tests

additionalNoiseSources.description: whether the entropy source includes additional noise sources according to Section 3.1.6 of SP 800-90B

sequencePosition.description: ordered list with other conditioning components on where in the sequence of operations the individual component occurs, must be 1, 2, ...n for n elements in this array

vetted.description: whether the conditioning components meets the SP 800-90B definition of vetted

bijectiveClaim.description: if non-vetted, whether the conditioning component is claimed to be bijective

description.description: brief description of the conditioning component, or if vetted, the ACVP algorithm name

minNin.description: minimum number of bits required to run the conditioning component

minHin.description: minimum amount of entropy required to run the conditioning component

nw.description: narrowest width of the conditioning component

nOut.description: output size in bits of the conditioning component

hOut.description: amount of entropy in bits output by the conditioning component
